description:
Configure the Automatic Backup Schedule in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus to ensure system data is protected. 

Goal: 
1. Enable the Scheduled Backup.
2. Set the frequency to Daily at 02:00 hours (2:00 AM).
3. Set the retention policy to keep the last 7 backups.
4. Enable notification on failure and set the email ID to 'admin@example.com'.

Starting State: ServiceDesk Plus is open. Login with 'administrator' / 'administrator'. Navigate to Admin > Backup Scheduling (or similar configuration menu).
